'''Red Watch''' was the codename for the unit formed by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] and [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] of [[Omega Squad]]. The pairing was decided by [[Kal Skirata]] during an unauthorized [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] terrorist ring.<ref name="TZ" />
